script: Teacher: Good morning everyone. I'm going to tell you about the school trip to the farm tomorrow. As I told you last week, you need to wait for the bus by the school gate, so don't go to the bus stop or come straight into the playground like you usually do. The farm is providing us all with a nice packed lunch, so there's no need to bring one yourself. It would be great if you could make sure you've got a drink though, as it can get quite hot on the bus. There are lots of different animals on the farm. You're all going to have a go at brushing the horses just after we arrive there at about 9 a.m. Shortly after this, you'll learn what farmers give lambs to eat, and you'll be able to give them their breakfast too. As well as the animals, the farm has lots of activities students can take part in. We're going to do some climbing on the special wall they have there after lunch, and maybe next time we can try one of the other activities, like fishing or playing baseball. We'll be setting off back to school at about 3:30 p.m. and we'll be back here at 4:15. So 45 minutes after the usual school finish time of 3:30. Please could you let your parents know, especially if they usually come to the school to pick you up. If you or your parents want to find out more about the farm before we go, you can visit their website and there's loads of information about it on there. I'll give you the website address. It's www.caffertys.farm.com. I'll spell that for you. It's C-A-F-F-E-R-T-Y-S.farm.com. Okay, see you all tomorrow.

items.quote: you need to wait for the bus by the school gate
items.uz: O'qituvchi avtobusni maktab darvozasi (gate) yonida kutish kerakligini aytadi. Avtobus bekati (bus stop) yoki o'yin maydonchasi (playground) bilan adashtirmang.

items.quote: make sure you've got a drink though
items.uz: Ferma tushlik (lunch) bilan ta'minlaydi, shuning uchun uni olib kelish shart emas. Lekin o'zingiz bilan ichimlik (drink) olishingiz kerakligi ta'kidlanadi.

items.quote: you'll learn what farmers give lambs to eat
items.uz: Otlarni (horses) tarashdan keyin, qo'zichoqlarni (lambs) ovqatlantirish faoliyati haqida gapiriladi. 'Lambs' so'zi ko'plikda yozilishi kerak.

items.quote: We're going to do some climbing on the special wall
items.uz: Tushlikdan keyin maxsus devorda toqqa chiqish (climbing) mashg'uloti bo'ladi. Baliq ovi (fishing) yoki beysbol (baseball) kabi boshqa variantlar bilan adashtirmang.
Avtobus fermadan 3:30 da yo'lga chiqadi, lekin maktabga qaytib kelish vaqti 4:15 deb aytiladi. Odatdagi dars tugash vaqti (3:30) bilan adashtirmang.
Veb-sayt nomi harfma-harf aytib beriladi. Har bir harfni diqqat bilan tinglab, to'g'ri ketma-ketlikda yozish lozim.
